name: PHOENIX OYSTER

plan.note: share of the old 100-bag split. The 130-bag plan (Joseph, 5 Nov 2026) is 52 blue, 46 lion's mane, 16 comb tooth, plus a 16-bag slot whose species you pick (PRODUCTION SEQUENCE)

blurb: NOT NAMED IN THE SOURCES. CATAWBA ITALIAN OYSTER IS THE STAND-IN.

overview.v: Phoenix is not named in the textbook or manual. The farm plan uses Catawba's Italian oyster figures as the stand-in.
Oysters share Pleurotus biology and differ mainly in colour and temperature preference.

timeline.k: Catawba Italian oyster, knock to first harvest

climate.v: Same as the other oysters: about 19 °C (66 °F) for blocks, about 18 °C (65 °F) for grain. Catawba incubates every species at about 18 °C (65 °F).
climate.n: Joseph, 9 Nov 2026: use the same figures as the other oysters unless Catawba has data.

climate.v: Same as the other oysters: 13-18 °C (55-65 °F). Catawba fruits it in rooms at 14-17 °C (58-62 °F).
climate.n: Joseph, 9 Nov 2026: use the same figures as the other oysters unless Catawba has data.

climate.v: Same as the other oysters: keep low. High CO2 gives long stems with no caps.
